'''Lumat''' was the name of a magical [[Axe/Legends|axe]] in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. The axe was wielded by the legendary hero [[Machook (legend)|Machook]], traditionally considered to have built the first tree village. "Lumat" was a popular name for Ewok males,<ref name="GCG" /> such as the [[Lumat/Legends|archer and woodcutter]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SW6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
